howToAnalyse: Each session carries benchmarkSummary (per engine/preprocess/scenario group) and validation. All summaries are re-derivable from sessions[].frames/events using the same aggregation (see reanalyzeExport in bench/export.ts).

benchmarkSummary.note: Groups never mix engines, preprocess modes, detectors, sources or scenarios.

validation.note: Device class is a heuristic from the camera name (name not stored). PHYSICAL_PRESUMED does not prove the night scenarios were run correctly; the Owner's N1..N6 notes and tester labels are the ground truth.
